2026 Season · Week 2 — Final
misbah456 drops 165.5
highest score of the week · updated Tue Sep 22

The week, in short

Two weeks in, misbah456 is the only team anyone needs to worry about. The 165.47–111.73 dismantling of nayvadiusdawg was both the week's highest score and its biggest blowout, powered by Josh Allen's 40.82 and CeeDee Lamb's 31.3. At 2-0 with a league-leading 332.43 points for, the gap between first and the field is already uncomfortable.

At the other end, tmahadik93 posted the week's low of 86.96 and lost to akm by 46 points, with akm spending almost none of it to quietly join the 2-0 club. The tightest matchup was sgundlapalli's 134.03–121.56 win over nshah3, settled by 12.47 points. Akilla got to 1-1 with a 111.47–93.75 win over sbhavsar, though Davante Adams did 36.5 of the heavy lifting.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 38.0 for nshah3 was the second-best individual score of the week and it counted for nothing, which is a particular kind of sting. Two teams remain winless: praddy13 is 0-2 with a league-low 189.64 points for and a defense that has already conceded 303.15, while kuku24 is 0-2 despite scoring 245.7 — the early signal that some rosters are cursed and some are just bad.
